Belarusian

[edit]
Belarusian Wikipedia has an article on:
карандаш
Wikipedia be

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • karandasz, karandaš — Łacinka (Belarusian Latin alphabet)

Etymology

[edit]

Ultimately from a Turkic language.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [karanˈdaʂ]
  • Rhymes: -aʂ
  • Hyphenation: ка‧ран‧даш

Noun

[edit]

каранда́ш • (karandáš) m inan (genitive карандаша́, nominative plural карандашы́, genitive plural карандашо́ў, relational adjective каранда́шны)

  1. pencil (a device for writing, sketching, drawing in the form of a thin stick with a graphite or other core)
    Synonym: ало́вак (alóvak)

Russian

[edit]
Russian Wikipedia has an article on:
карандаш
Wikipedia ru

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • каранда́шъ (karandáš) — pre-1918 spelling

Etymology

[edit]

In Russian from the 16–17th centuries. Borrowing from a Turkic language. Compare Turkish karataş (“black slate”), composed of kara (“black”) + taş (“stone”), Tatar кара таш (qara taş, “graphite, black lead”). The origin of epenthetic -н- (-n-) is unclear. Compare каланча́ (kalančá) for the same epenthesis.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [kərɐnˈdaʂ]
  • Audio:(file)
  • Rhymes: -aʂ

Noun

[edit]

каранда́ш • (karandáš) m inan (genitive карандаша́, nominative plural карандаши́, genitive plural карандаше́й, relational adjective каранда́шный, diminutive каранда́шик)

  1. pencil
    У тебя́ есть каранда́ш? ― U tebjá jestʹ karandáš? ― Do you have a pencil?
  2. (uncountable) pencil marks, pencil drawing
  3. (by extension) stick (a small, thin cylinder of some material)
    кле́ящий каранда́ш ― kléjaščij karandáš ― glue stick
    ля́писный каранда́ш ― ljápisnyj karandáš ― silver nitrate caustic stick

Derived terms

[edit]
  • каранда́шница f (karandášnica)

Compounds:

  • брать на каранда́ш impf (bratʹ na karandáš), взять на каранда́ш pf (vzjatʹ na karandáš)

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Azerbaijani: karandaş
  • → Chuvash: кӑранташ (kărant̬aš)
  • → Ingrian: krandošši, krantossi, krandašši
  • → Kazakh: қарындаш (qaryndaş)
  • → Korean: 가름다시 (gareumdasi) (Yukjin)
  • → Mongolian: харандаа (xarandaa)
    • * → Kalmyk: харнда (xarnda)
  • → Kildin Sami: карндашш (karndašš)
  • → Skolt Sami: karndaš
  • → Southern Altai: карандаш (karandaš)
  • → Yakut: харандаас (qarandaas)
  • → Yup'ik: kalantaassaq

  • ка́рий (kárij)

instruments:

  • точи́лка f (točílka)
